variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.body: The home world has changed the colony's charter. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Colonial charter amended
variants.body: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
